name: io.github.lordvadar10/invoice4u
description: MCP server for Invoice4U (invoice4u.co.il) — read-only access to documents, customers and Israeli allocation-number status. One organisation per process.

environmentVariables.name: INVOICE4U_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Which Invoice4U environment to use: qa or production. Required — production is never selected implicitly.

environmentVariables.name: INVOICE4U_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: macOS Keychain account label holding the API key (service: invoice4u). Use this or INVOICE4U_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: INVOICE4U_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Invoice4U API key, for environments with no Keychain. Use this or INVOICE4U_ACCOUNT.

environmentVariables.name: INVOICE4U_EXPECT_ORG
environmentVariables.description: Refuse to start unless the API key opens this organisation identifier. Recommended when several Invoice4U accounts are in use.

environmentVariables.name: INVOICE4U_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Reserved for a future write surface. No write tools exist in 0.1.0.
